hub.title: Shipping Process Center
hub.description: Manage order source, tasks, picking, packing, loading, approval and ERP finalisation in one place.

orderedAssigned.title: Order-Based · Assigned
orderedAssigned.description: Select open sales orders, allocate lines and assign the shipping task.

stockAssigned.title: Free Stock · Assigned
stockAssigned.description: Create a planned shipment and operator task without an order reference.

orderedDirect.title: Order-Based · Direct
orderedDirect.description: When policy allows, start an order-based shipment without creating a task.

stockDirect.title: Free Stock · Direct
stockDirect.description: Execute an urgent shipment with stock, location, lot, serial and quantity validation.

records.title: Shipping Records
records.description: Track planned, picked, packed, loaded and shipped quantities.

settings.title: Shipping Settings
settings.description: Manage flow variants, reservation, packing, partial execution, approval and ERP rules.

policy.title: Shipping Process Policy
policy.description: Rules are snapshotted onto the header when a draft is created; open shipments are not affected by later setting changes.
